title: FP&A Analyst
description:
"At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."

Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.

We are looking for a driven and commercially minded Commercial Finance Analyst to join our wider Finance Business Partnering team. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional who wants to accelerate their career in commercial finance and develop into a Finance Business Partner.

Working closely with sales and marketing leaders across a global business, you will provide high-quality analysis, reporting and forecasting to support decision-making and improve performance. A significant focus will be on sales and marketing performance, revenue drivers, return on investment and the development of Power BI reporting that gives stakeholders clear, actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Commercial Finance and Business Partnering
  • Support sales, marketing and operational leaders with financial analysis and commercial insight that aids decision-making and performance improvement.
  • Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the business and become a trusted source of financial information and analysis.
  • Participate in business reviews and performance discussions, helping stakeholders understand results and the underlying drivers.
  • Support commercial initiatives through analysis, constructive challenge and clear recommendations.
  • Financial Analysis and Reporting
  • Analyse revenue, costs, marketing investment, customer acquisition, sales productivity and profitability trends to identify risks and opportunities.
  • Deliver timely and accurate management reporting with clear commentary on business performance.
  • Power BI and Data Analytics
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions for finance and business stakeholders.
  • Improve reporting automation and data visualization to provide timely, accessible and actionable insight.
  • Budgeting and Forecasting
  • Support budgeting and forecasting processes across assigned business areas.
  • Prepare forecast updates and provide variance analysis against budget, forecast, and prior periods.
  • Help stakeholders understand forecast assumptions, trends, and key sensitivities.
  • Performance Management and Commercial Support
  • Monitor performance against key financial and operational metrics and highlight emerging risks and opportunities.
  • Assist with financial models, business cases, and commercial analysis for investment and growth initiatives.
  • Support assessments of sales effectiveness, marketing return on investment, and customer acquisition performance.
  • Stakeholder Communication and Continuous Improvement
  • Prepare and present reports and analysis to finance leadership, sales leaders, marketing leaders, and operational managers.
  • Translate complex financial and operational information into clear, practical insights for non-finance stakeholders.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience:

Essential

  • A degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified, part-qualified or actively studying towards a professional qualification.
  • Approximately three to five years of relevant experience in finance, FP&A, commercial finance, management accounting or financial analysis.
  • Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and performance analysis.
  • Strong analytical capability and confidence working with large datasets.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including financial modelling, reporting and analysis.
  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non-finance stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.

Equal Opportunities

As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.

If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.

However, we recognise that skills and experience come in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every criterion. If you are passionate about this role and believe you have the right mindset and transferrable skills, we would love to hear from you!
